final: WITH j AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS ordertune, f.rebtotal AS rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS gap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS a FROM j), g AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(gap) AS avg_relative_gap FROM j GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - overall.a AS margin_above_overall FROM g, overall WHERE g.avg_rebate > overall.a ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
